entities.summary: Waldemar Wilenius was a renowned Finnish architect at the end of the 19th century and beginning of the 20th century designing buildings in first a Neo-Renaissance style before moving to an Art Nouveau style. Wilenius completed his studies at the Finnish Polytechnical Institute in 1889, after which he undertook further studies at the Royal Swedish Academy of Arts in Stockholm and Technische Universität Berlin. After his studies he returned to Helsinki where he worked at the National Board of Building, fulfilling various positions until 1889.
